project_type: Greenfield hackathon prototype: two ESP-IDF firmware projects (ESP-NOW CSI transmitter + CSI receiver derived from espressif/esp-csi get-started examples) plus a local Python backend (serial ingest, CSI parsing, signal processing, heuristic fall detection), a dark-mode local web dashboard (Flask 3.0.3 + self-contained vanilla JS/canvas, no CDN), a synthetic simulation mode, and optional scikit-learn Random Forest training.
language: Python 3.12 (miniconda base, offline) / 3.11 (online setup) for host software, C for ESP-IDF firmware, vanilla JavaScript/HTML/CSS for the dashboard UI
build_system: Python: venv driven by a root Makefile. `make setup` = online install of pinned requirements.txt; `make setup-offline` = venv with --system-site-packages from /Users/christopherryan/miniconda3/bin/python3.12 (which already has numpy 2.2.6, scipy 1.15.1, pandas 2.2.3, pyserial 3.5, flask 3.0.3, werkzeug 3.0.4, pytest 8.3.5). Optional requirements-ml.txt (scikit-learn, joblib). Firmware: ESP-IDF idf.py (CMake), NOT installed on this machine.
test_framework: pytest, tests in tests/ (test_*.py), text fixtures in tests/fixtures/ (classic_esp32s3_sample.txt: 13 csi / 4 malformed / 4 seq gaps; c5c6_sample.txt: 7 csi / 1 malformed). Flask test client for dashboard API tests. No hardware required for any test.
build_command: make setup-offline (in this environment) or make setup (with network); .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q backend dashboard simulation; node --check dashboard/static/app.js
verification_instructions: 1) make setup-offline (or make setup) succeeds. 2) make test passes. 3) .venv/bin/python -m backend.cli ports runs (no ESP32 connected; expect only system ports, excluded). 4) .venv/bin/python -m backend.cli monitor --replay tests/fixtures/classic_esp32s3_sample.txt --duration 3 prints counts/rates/amplitudes. 5) Dashboard: .venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 --replay tests/fixtures/classic_esp32s3_sample.txt in background, curl http://127.0.0.1:8599/api/status and / , then kill it. 6) node --check dashboard/static/app.js. 7) Firmware cannot be compiled (no ESP-IDF); review C against /tmp/esp-csi references only; never claim firmware build or hardware verification.

contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING docs (greenfield). User requirements: no fabricated readings in live hardware mode; simulated data clearly labelled synthetic everywhere (UI banner, recorded metadata, synthetic=true flag) and never used as accuracy evidence; never imply medical validation (persistent disclaimer in UI and README); no classifier accuracy claims without held-out real-session evaluation; two ESP32s only, no router, no mesh; offline operation; no invented ESP-IDF APIs.
key_patterns: Firmware (done in FEAT-001): firmware/transmitter and firmware/receiver adapted from official csi_send/csi_recv; ESP-NOW broadcast from MAC 1a:00:00:00:00:00, channel 11 HT40; receiver queues CSI from the callback to a printer task; LLTF-only (128 values) by default on classic chips; EG_RX_STATS,<uptime_ms>,<csi_rx_total>,<csi_rx_rate_hz>,<queue_drops>,<seq_gaps>,<last_rssi> and EG_TX_STATS,<uptime_ms>,<sent_ok>,<send_fail>,<rate_hz> lines. Backend API (FEAT-001): backend.csi_parser.parse_any(line, host_ts)->ParsedLine(kind csi|malformed|stats|header|other|empty, packet, error, stats); CSIPacket (seq, mac, rssi, noise_floor, channel, secondary_channel, bandwidth, len, chip_family 'classic'|'c5c6', csi complex, amplitude, phase, first_word_invalid, raw_line); valid_subcarrier_amplitudes(pkt) (52 LLTF amps, NaN where masked, for classic; all subcarriers for c5c6), subcarrier_labels(pkt), VALID_LLTF_INDICES. backend.sources: LineSource.lines() yields (host_ts, line), stop(), status: SourceStatus(kind, port, connected, finished, reconnect_count, last_error, bytes_read, lines_read, extra); SerialSource(port|'auto', baud=921600, serial_factory, port_resolver); ReplaySource(path, speed (0=as fast as possible), loop, line_rate_hz) auto-detecting RawRecorder CSV vs raw logs. backend.buffer.CSIBuffer(maxlen=3000).ingest(ts,line)/add_packet/snapshot(now)->BufferStats/packets(last_n)/latest(). backend.recorder.RawRecorder(path, extra_fields).write(ts, line, extra), RAW_FIELDS, export_amplitudes_csv(packets, path). backend.ports.list_candidates/auto_select/probe_port. backend.cli: ports, monitor. Python conventions: plain packages backend/, dashboard/, simulation/ at repo root, dataclasses + JSON config, numpy/scipy DSP, `from __future__ import annotations`, module docstrings. Dashboard: Flask app factory create_app(engine) in dashboard/server.py, JSON API under /api/*, static single page in dashboard/static/ polling with fetch, canvas-drawn charts, `python -m dashboard` entry point. All sources (serial, replay, simulation) yield raw text lines through the same parser and pipeline.
